provenance.dimension_basis: ACP RFS12TS family specification; nominal overall 551 x 533 x 365 mm, cavity 359 x 413 x 226 mm. Visible earlier lettermark and six-position unlit display modeled from source

hidden_structure.statement: Local measurements estimated from visible source geometry; hidden interlock/spring/material physics not established.

checks.principal_model: RFS12TS older scripted Amana mark, side keypad and short pull
checks.fixed_stage: Tangyuan scene000015 kitchen stage, shared placement and light setup
checks.visible_mechanism: Three source-observed opening/closing sequences retained with source-frame angle keys
checks.door_panel: Flush metal door/control housing faces, recessed black membrane
checks.cavity: Single connected rounded cabinet/flange/liner; sealed cooking floor
checks.camera: Every retained source frame receives source-derived camera registration; padded Blender frusta verified by 27 noncoplanar projection points
checks.encoded_video: Both videos decoded and frame count equals ordered source mapping

limitations: Local face dimensions, hidden hinge pin, latches and shell thickness are inferred, with nominal family envelope taken from manufacturer documentation.
Source people, food, editor titles, wipes and fades are omitted from generated views; the requested scope is microwave structure, visible mechanism and camera.
Manual door angles and occluded camera gaps are visual estimates; recorded landmark/feature residuals are not ground-truth shape accuracy.
Display text and small printed glyph shapes are approximations; membrane presses have no reliably visible physical travel.
No force, contact, safety interlock or cooking simulation was run.
